vulnerabilities.description: SSRF in Flask app - 'url' parameter fetches arbitrary URLs. Accessing 169.254.169.254 returns simulated AWS IMDSv1 credentials.
AWS IMDS response includes SSH password in Token field: ssh_password=MetadataSecret123!
SUID bit set on find binary for privilege escalation from operatoruser to root

safety_invariants: SI-01: All commands must pass through authorize_shell_command()
SI-02: No dangerous commands in objective_command_map
SI-03: Reverse shell listener must be provisioned by CapabilityBroker
SI-04: Every shell session must have dual-gate auth
SI-06: Dead shell sessions detected via 15s timeout -> TERMINATED
SI-07: Only authorized commands within ENGAGEMENT_CONFIG scope execute
SI-08: All shell commands must be logged with timestamp and outcome
SI-09: No component bypasses CapabilityBroker for provisioning
SI-10: Falsification deduplication requires content_hash matching
